hypothesis: H31-1: choosing emission candidates and dot order from the kernel-credit field u = value_field(score) (instead of raw-score ridge candidates) raises holdout DTI at equal budget.
mechanism: u sums each pixel's 3-px triangular-kernel neighbourhood of the normalised score, i.e. the expected credit one dot collects; selecting and ordering dots by u should move dots to where expected credit is highest per unit FP.
non_fault_process_that_could_mimic_it: Smoothing a score surface with a 3-px kernel favours broad, high-score regions (basin margins, thermal-rich lowlands, DEM-ridge clusters) that carry no fault; a gain could be a regional-density effect, not fault detection. Also: the catalogue-proximity bias (dots hugging visible traces) inflates holdout credit because the holdout truth is the catalogue itself (IR-32-PROXY-01).
